exercises.title: Sort colours 0/1/2 in place in one pass — the Dutch national flag
exercises.problemHtml:
a contains only 0, 1 and 2. Complete static void sortColors(int[] a): rearrange it in place into 0…0 1…1 2…2 in a single pass, without Arrays.sort and without another array.

Keep three regions: a[0..low-1] = 0, a[low..mid-1] = 1, a[high+1..] = 2, and a[mid..high] unknown. Look at a[mid]: 0 → swap with low, advance both; 1 → advance mid; 2 → swap with high, move high back — and do NOT advance mid (the value that came in is still unknown).

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 2 case(s) (1 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
a chỉ gồm 0, 1 và 2. Hoàn thiện sortColors(a): sắp lại tại chỗ thành 0…0 1…1 2…2 trong một lượt, không dùng Arrays.sort và không dùng mảng khác.

Giữ ba vùng: a[0..low-1] = 0, a[low..mid-1] = 1, a[high+1..] = 2, còn a[mid..high] chưa xét. Xem a[mid]: 0 → đổi với low, tăng cả hai; 1 → tăng mid; 2 → đổi với high, lùi high — và KHÔNG tăng mid (giá trị vừa đổi vào chưa được xét).

exercises.title: Longest substring with at most k distinct characters — a growing/shrinking window
concepts: sliding window with a count map
each index enters and leaves once
exercises.problemHtml:
Complete static int longestWithAtMostK(String s, int k): the length of the longest substring of s that contains at most k different characters (k ≤ 0 → 0). Example: "eceba", k = 2 → 3 ("ece"); "aaabbccc", k = 1 → 3.

Extend the window with right, count characters in a map; while the map has more than k keys, remove s[left] and advance left. Every index enters and leaves the window once: O(n). The complexity check uses a string of 1,000,000 characters.

⏱ Complexity check. One case runs your code on a large input (n = 1,000,000 characters) inside a 3-second limit. An O(n) solution finishes in a fraction of a second on any ordinary laptop; an O(n²) (restarting from every left end) one needs far longer and the case prints TOO SLOW. The limit is generous on purpose — if it fails, the algorithm is the problem, not your machine.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Hoàn thiện longestWithAtMostK(s, k): độ dài xâu con dài nhất của s chứa tối đa k ký tự khác nhau (k ≤ 0 → 0). Ví dụ: "eceba", k = 2 → 3 ("ece"); "aaabbccc", k = 1 → 3.

Mở rộng cửa sổ bằng right, đếm ký tự trong một map; khi map có nhiều hơn k khoá thì bỏ s[left] và tăng left. Mỗi chỉ số vào và ra khỏi cửa sổ đúng một lần: O(n). Kiểm độ phức tạp dùng xâu 1.000.000 ký tự.

⏱ Kiểm độ phức tạp. Một ca chạy code của bạn với input LỚN (n = 1,000,000 characters) trong hạn 3 giây. Lời giải O(n) xong trong chưa tới một giây trên laptop bình thường; bản O(n²) (restarting from every left end) cần lâu hơn rất nhiều và ca in TOO SLOW. Hạn đặt rộng có chủ ý — trượt ca này thì do thuật toán, không phải do máy bạn.

exercises.title: Count subarrays whose sum is divisible by k — prefix sums and remainders
concepts: equal prefix remainders bracket a divisible subarray
exercises.problemHtml:
Complete static long countDivisible(int[] a, int k) (k ≥ 1, values may be negative): the number of non-empty contiguous subarrays whose sum is a multiple of k. Example {4,5,0,-2,-3,1}, k = 5 → 7.

sum(i..j) = P[j+1] − P[i] is divisible by k exactly when P[i] and P[j+1] have the same remainder. Count remainders of the prefixes seen so far (start with the empty prefix, remainder 0). Careful: in Java -7 % 5 == -2 — bring it into [0, k) with ((x % k) + k) % k. Use a long for the answer: a million zeros give 5·10¹¹ subarrays.

⏱ Complexity check. One case runs your code on a large input (n = 1,000,000 elements) inside a 3-second limit. An O(n + k) solution finishes in a fraction of a second on any ordinary laptop; an O(n²) (every pair of ends) one needs far longer and the case prints TOO SLOW. The limit is generous on purpose — if it fails, the algorithm is the problem, not your machine.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Hoàn thiện countDivisible(a, k) (k ≥ 1, giá trị có thể âm): số đoạn con liên tiếp khác rỗng có tổng là bội của k. Ví dụ {4,5,0,-2,-3,1}, k = 5 → 7.

sum(i..j) = P[j+1] − P[i] chia hết cho k đúng khi P[i] và P[j+1] cùng số dư. Đếm số dư của các tiền tố đã gặp (bắt đầu bằng tiền tố rỗng, dư 0). Cẩn thận: trong Java -7 % 5 == -2 — đưa về [0, k) bằng ((x % k) + k) % k. Đáp án dùng long: một triệu số 0 cho 5·10¹¹ đoạn con.

⏱ Kiểm độ phức tạp. Một ca chạy code của bạn với input LỚN (n = 1,000,000 elements) trong hạn 3 giây. Lời giải O(n + k) xong trong chưa tới một giây trên laptop bình thường; bản O(n²) (every pair of ends) cần lâu hơn rất nhiều và ca in TOO SLOW. exercises.title: Flight bookings — m range updates with a difference array
exercises.problemHtml:
Flights are numbered 1…n. bookings[i] = {first, last, seats} reserves seats seats on every flight first…last (inclusive). Complete static long[] bookings(int[][] bookings, int n): the total seats per flight.

Example n = 5, bookings [1,2,10] [2,3,20] [2,5,25] → [10, 55, 45, 25, 25]. Adding to every flight of every range is O(m · n) — the complexity check has 200,000 bookings over 200,000 flights. Instead write +seats at first−1 and −seats at last in a difference array, then one prefix-sum pass.

⏱ Complexity check. One case runs your code on a large input (n = 200,000 bookings × 200,000 flights) inside a 3-second limit. An O(m + n) solution finishes in a fraction of a second on any ordinary laptop; an O(m · n) (adding to every flight of every range) one needs far longer and the case prints TOO SLOW. exercises.title: Trapping rain water with two pointers in O(n) time and O(1) memory
exercises.problemHtml:
h[i] ≥ 0 are the heights of bars of width 1. Complete static long trap(int[] h): how much water stays after rain. Example {0,1,0,2,1,0,1,3,2,1,2,1} → 6.

Above bar i the water level is min(tallest bar on its left, tallest on its right). Two pointers from both ends: if h[lo] < h[hi], the left side is the lower one, so the water above lo depends only on leftMax — settle it and move lo; otherwise settle hi with rightMax. O(n), O(1) memory; the complexity check has 2,000,000 bars.

exercises.title: Maximum sum of a circular subarray — Kadane twice
concepts: Kadane for max and min subarray
exercises.problemHtml:
a (n ≥ 1) is circular: after the last element comes the first. Complete static long maxCircular(int[] a): the largest sum of a non-empty contiguous piece of the circle (each element used at most once). Examples: {5,-3,5} → 10 (5 + 5 across the end), {-3,-2,-3} → -2.

A best piece either does not wrap (ordinary Kadane) or wraps — then what is left out is a contiguous middle piece with the minimum sum, so wrap = total − minSubarray. Exception: if every element is negative, the minimum subarray is the whole array and "wrap" would be empty.

⏱ Complexity check. One case runs your code on a large input (n = 2,000,000 elements) inside a 3-second limit. An O(n) solution finishes in a fraction of a second on any ordinary laptop; an O(n²) (every start, every length) one needs far longer and the case prints TOO SLOW.
